repos.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
repos.summary_zh: Orca 是一款下一代 AI 智能体开发 IDE，支持在 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 上并行运行 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等多种 CLI 编码智能体。每个智能体独立工作树，统一管理与追踪，专为提升开发者 100 倍效率而设计。
repos.summary_en: Orca is a next-gen IDE for building with coding agents, enabling side-by-side execution of multiple CLI agents like Claude Code and OpenCode on macOS, Windows, and Linux. Each agent operates in its own worktree, centrally tracked and managed for maximum developer productivity.

repos.description: Make humans and AI agents work as one team — open-source and self-hostable.
repos.summary_zh: Multica 是一个开源、可自托管的 AI 智能体协同工作空间，将人类开发者与 Claude Code、Codex 等 26 种编码智能体统一在同一看板。智能体像团队成员一样领取任务、汇报进度、提出阻塞并等待人类审查，彻底解决多 Agent 上下文割裂与重复沟通问题。
repos.summary_en: Multica is an open-source, self-hostable workspace that unifies human developers with 26 AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex on a shared Kanban board. Agents act as teammates—claiming issues, reporting progress, raising blockers, and waiting for human review—eliminating context fragmentation across multiple agent sessions.

repos.description: 本文原文由知名 Hacker Eric S. Raymond 所撰寫，教你如何正確的提出技術問題並獲得你滿意的答案。
repos.summary_zh: 本指南由知名黑客 Eric S. Raymond 撰写，系统阐述高效提问的技术沟通原则，涵盖问题筛选、论坛选择、标题撰写、代码呈现等关键技巧，帮助开发者获得精准解答，提升开源社区协作效率。
repos.summary_en: Authored by renowned hacker Eric S. Raymond, this guide systematically outlines principles for effective technical communication, covering question selection, forum choice, title writing, and code presentation to help developers obtain accurate answers and improve open-source community collaboration.

repos.description: Your Personal AI Assistant; easy to install, deploy on your own machine or on the cloud; supports multiple chat apps with easily extensible capabilities.
repos.summary_zh: QwenPaw 是一款个人 AI 助手，支持本地或云端部署，数据完全自主可控。内置日程管理、文档处理等技能，支持多智能体协作与自定义扩展，兼容多种聊天平台，易于安装与集成。
repos.summary_en: QwenPaw is a personal AI assistant that can be deployed locally or in the cloud, ensuring full data control. It features built-in skills like scheduling and document processing, supports multi-agent collaboration and extensible custom skills, and integrates with multiple chat platforms.

repos.summary_zh: TaskMatrix 通过连接 ChatGPT 与一系列视觉基础模型，实现聊天中发送和接收图像。其核心创新在于引入模板机制，将人类经验转化为多模型协作的预定义执行流，支持图像编辑、目标检测、语义分割等复杂视觉任务，无需额外训练即可实现跨模型协同。
repos.summary_en: TaskMatrix connects ChatGPT with visual foundation models to enable image sending/receiving during chat. It introduces a template mechanism—pre-defined execution flows that leverage human expertise to orchestrate complex multi-model tasks like image editing, object detection, and segmentation, enabling seamless collaboration without additional training.

repos.description: Privacy first, AI meeting assistant with 4x faster Parakeet/Whisper live transcription, speaker diarization, and Ollama summarization built on Rust. 100% local processing. no cloud required. Meetily (Meetly Ai - https://meetily.ai) is the #1 Self-hosted, Open-source Ai meeting note taker for macOS & Windows. Understand How to write meeting minutes
repos.summary_zh: Meetily 是一款基于 Rust 构建的隐私优先 AI 会议助手，支持 macOS 和 Windows 平台。它利用本地 AI 模型（如 Ollama）实现 4 倍速的实时转录、说话人分离及会议摘要，所有数据均在本地处理，无需云端，完美契合企业对数据主权与合规性的严苛要求。
repos.summary_en: Meetily is a privacy-first AI meeting assistant built on Rust for macOS and Windows. Leveraging local AI models like Ollama, it delivers 4x faster real-time transcription, speaker diarization, and summarization with 100% local processing, ensuring complete data sovereignty and compliance without cloud dependency.

repos.description: Bridge local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex) to messaging platforms (Feishu/Lark, DingTalk, Slack, Telegram, Discord, LINE, WeChat Work). Chat with your AI dev assistant from anywhere — no public IP required for most platforms.
repos.summary_zh: CC-Connect 是一款将本地 AI 编程助手（Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Codex）桥接到飞书、钉钉、Slack、Telegram、Discord、LINE、企业微信等即时通讯平台的中间件工具。用户无需公网 IP，即可通过消息平台随时随地与本地 AI 开发助手对话协作，实现远程编程辅助。核心亮点是跨平台消息桥接与零公网部署，极大提升了 AI 编程助手的可访问性和使用灵活性。
repos.summary_en: CC-Connect bridges local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex) to messaging platforms including Feishu, DingTalk, Slack, Telegram, Discord, LINE, and WeChat Work. It enables users to chat with their local AI dev assistant from anywhere without requiring a public IP for most platforms. The core value lies in cross-platform message bridging and zero-public-IP deployment, significantly enhancing the accessibility and flexibility of AI coding assistants.

repos.description: ShowDoc is a tool greatly applicable for an IT team to share documents online一个非常适合IT团队的在线API文档、技术文档工具
repos.summary_zh: ShowDoc 是一款专为 IT 团队设计的在线文档协作工具，支持 API 文档、数据字典和技术说明的编写与管理。采用 Markdown 编辑，提供模板插入、版本历史、权限控制等功能，支持响应式网页和离线导出，显著提升团队文档协作效率。
repos.summary_en: ShowDoc is an online documentation tool designed for IT teams to create and share API documents, data dictionaries, and technical specs. It features Markdown editing, template insertion, version history, permission management, responsive design, and offline export, enhancing team collaboration efficiency.

repos.description: 收集整理远程工作相关的资料
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库系统整理远程工作相关资源，涵盖文章、问题解答、团队案例、视频播客、工具站点等，聚焦中国受众，提供远程办公经验分享、招聘信息、协作工具推荐及行业报告，助力远程工作者获取实用信息与职业发展支持。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates comprehensive resources on remote work, including articles, Q&A, team cases, videos, podcasts, tools, and reports, primarily targeting Chinese audiences. It offers practical guidance on remote work, job opportunities, collaboration tools, and industry insights to support freelancers and remote professionals.

repos.description: Ekko Studio is a local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows, available on desktop and the web.
repos.summary_zh: Ekko Studio 是一款本地优先的 AI 工作空间，支持多代理实时协作、可视化工作流构建与编码任务。集成 Hermes、Claude Code、Codex 等主流 AI 代理运行时，提供桌面端、Web 控制台与 Docker 部署方案，适用于开发者与团队的高效 AI 协作场景。
repos.summary_en: Ekko Studio is a local-first AI workspace supporting multi-agent collaboration, visual workflow building, and coding tasks. It integrates Hermes, Claude Code, Codex and other mainstream AI agent runtimes, offering desktop app, web console and Docker deployment options for developer and team efficiency.

repos.description: 免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选资源、每天检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox / 影视仓空壳软件/配置地址、IPTV直播源、会员拼团、影视相关开源项目。开源，社区共同维护。
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Zhuiju Free 是一个开源、免费且无广告的追剧资源导航项目。它通过人工精选与每日自动化检测，收录了涵盖在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、TVBox配置及IPTV直播源等80余个高质量资源。项目采用社区共同维护模式，旨在为用户提供纯净、有效且持续更新的影视观看解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Zhuiju Free is an open-source, ad-free resource guide for tracking dramas and movies. Combining manual curation with daily automated availability checks, it aggregates over 80 high-quality resources including online streaming, apps, cloud storage searches, magnet links, TVBox configurations, and IPTV sources. Maintained by the community, it aims to provide a pure, reliable, and continuously updated viewing solution.

repos.description: A persistent service that generates mock data quickly and provids visualization view.
repos.summary_zh: Easy Mock 是一个快速生成模拟数据并提供可视化界面的持久化服务，支持团队协作、Swagger 导入、Mock.js 语法及自定义响应配置，适用于前后端分离开发中的接口模拟与测试。
repos.summary_en: Easy Mock is a persistent service that quickly generates mock data with a visualization interface, supporting team collaboration, Swagger import, Mock.js schema, and customizable responses for frontend-backend development and API testing.

repos.description: A smarter, self-hosted AI assistant — multi-user, multi-agent.
repos.summary_zh: Octop 是腾讯开源的自托管多用户 AI 助手，采用多 Agent 架构支持团队协作与个人使用。集成专家库、RAG 知识库、MCP/OAuth 连接器生态，支持 MBTI 人格模板、IDE 集成与浏览器自动化，JWT 隔离保障数据隐私本地化运行。
repos.summary_en: Octop is Tencent's open-source self-hosted multi-user AI assistant featuring a multi-agent architecture for team and personal collaboration. Integrates expert libraries, RAG knowledge base, MCP/OAuth connectors, MBTI personas, IDE integration and browser automation, with JWT isolation ensuring local privacy.

repos.description: Simple forum software for building great communities.
repos.summary_zh: Flarum 是一个轻量级、现代化的论坛软件，专为构建高效社区而设计。基于 PHP 开发，采用 Mithril 前端框架，具备简洁界面、快速部署和强大扩展能力，支持插件化定制，适用于各类在线讨论场景。
repos.summary_en: Flarum is a lightweight, modern forum software designed to build great online communities. Built with PHP and powered by the Mithril JavaScript framework, it offers a clean interface, fast deployment, and extensive extensibility through a robust Extension API, ideal for customizable discussion platforms.

repos.description: p2p.kiwi 🥝, Cross-Platform screen 🖥️ sharing 📡 made simple ⚡.
repos.summary_zh: p2p.kiwi是一款跨平台P2P屏幕共享工具，支持Mac、Windows和Linux系统。无需注册账户，不依赖服务器基础设施，仅通过STUN/TURN及信令服务器完成初始连接交换。适合远程协作、技术支持与即时屏幕分享场景，实现高效安全的点对点数据传输。
repos.summary_en: p2p.kiwi is a cross-platform P2P screen sharing tool supporting Mac, Windows, and Linux. No account registration required, operates without server infrastructure beyond STUN/TURN and signaling servers for initial connection setup. Ideal for remote collaboration, tech support, and instant screen sharing with secure peer-to-peer data transfer.

repos.description: 多模型协作工作流引擎 — /ccg:go 一个命令，AI 自动分析意图、选择策略、编排 Codex + Gemini + Claude 协作执行
repos.summary_zh: CCG 是一个多模型协作开发系统，通过 Claude 编排 Codex（后端）与 Gemini（前端），提供 28 个命令覆盖完整开发流程。支持零配置路由、安全补丁审查及 OPSX 规范驱动开发，实现 AI 智能体协同编程。
repos.summary_en: CCG is a multi-model collaboration system where Claude orchestrates Codex (backend) and Gemini (frontend), offering 28 slash commands for full-stack development. Features zero-config routing, secure patch review, and OPSX-driven spec development for AI agent teamwork.

repos.description: The open source Trello alternative.
repos.summary_zh: Kan是一个开源的Trello替代方案，采用Next.js与tRPC技术栈构建，支持看板权限控制、团队协作者邀请、Trello一键导入、标签筛选、活动日志追踪及自定义模板等功能，提供Railway一键部署与Docker Compose自托管两种方案，适合中小团队进行轻量级项目管理与任务协作。
repos.summary_en: Kan is an open-source Trello alternative built with Next.js and tRPC, offering board visibility control, team collaboration, Trello imports, labels, activity logs, and templates. Supports Railway one-click deployment and Docker self-hosting, ideal for small to medium teams seeking lightweight project management and task collaboration.

repos.description: 🎒 飞书  ×（GPT-4 + GPT-4V + DALL·E-3 + Whisper）=  飞一般的工作体验  🚀 语音对话、角色扮演、多话题讨论、图片创作、表格分析、文档导出 🚀
repos.summary_zh: 飞书 × OpenAI 深度集成工具，支持 GPT-4、GPT-4V、DALL·E-3 和 Whisper，提供语音对话、图片生成、表格分析、角色扮演等功能，无缝嵌入飞书生态，支持多场景 AI 工作流，提升企业协作效率。
repos.summary_en: Feishu OpenAI integrates GPT-4, GPT-4V, DALL·E-3, and Whisper into Feishu, enabling voice chat, image generation, table analysis, role-playing, and more. It enhances enterprise collaboration with AI-powered workflows, supporting private deployment, cloud functions, and Docker.

repos.description: Bento, the office suite that fits in a file
repos.summary_zh: Bento 是一款单文件演示文稿工具，将编辑器、查看器和动画引擎全部封装在一个约 560KB 的 HTML 文件中。它采用纯 JSON 数据结构，实现本地优先、离线可用，支持端到端加密的实时协作与 AI 智能体直接编辑，是 PowerPoint 的轻量级、无云端依赖的替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Bento is a single-file presentation tool that packs an editor, viewer, and animation engine into a ~560KB HTML file. Utilizing a pure JSON data structure, it offers local-first, offline capabilities with E2EE real-time collaboration and native AI agent editing, serving as a lightweight, cloud-free alternative to PowerPoint.

repos.description: Collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace: aggregate sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok Build, etc. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.
repos.summary_zh: Codeg 是一个企业级多智能体编码工作台，统一集成 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等本地 AI 编程助手。支持桌面应用、独立服务器或 Docker 部署，提供浏览器远程访问。核心功能包括对话聚合、Git worktree 并行开发、MCP/Skills 管理、Telegram/Lark 等聊天渠道集成及终端集成，实现全链路工程化开发流程。
repos.summary_en: Codeg is an enterprise-grade multi-agent coding workspace that unifies local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) in a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container. It enables remote development via any browser with conversation aggregation, parallel git worktree workflows, MCP/Skills management, chat channel integration (Telegram, Lark, iLink), and integrated terminal/file/Git workflows.

repos.description: Remote Control for Codex.
repos.summary_zh: Remodex 是一款本地优先的开源桥接工具，结合 iOS 应用与 macOS 后台服务，实现 iPhone 对 OpenAI Codex 的远程控制。支持端到端加密配对、实时流式交互、Git 操作、子智能体调用及结构化规划模式，提供低延迟响应与细粒度访问控制，全程无需依赖公共服务器。
repos.summary_en: Remodex is a local-first open-source bridge with an iOS app that enables remote control of OpenAI Codex from your iPhone. It features end-to-end encrypted pairing, real-time streaming, Git actions, subagents, planning mode, and secure access controls—all running on-device without relying on public endpoints.

repos.description: 🌊 AChat - An open-source/self-hosted/local-first AI platform, designed for enterprises and teams, perfectly combining powerful local processing capabilities with seamless remote synchronization.
repos.summary_zh: AChat 是一个开源、自托管的企业级 AI 协作平台，支持本地化处理与远程同步，提供用户管理、支付集成、内容过滤等全套功能，适用于团队和组织内部 AI 应用部署。
repos.summary_en: AChat is an open-source, self-hosted AI platform designed for enterprises and teams, combining local processing with remote synchronization. It offers user management, payment integration, and content filtering out of the box.

repos.description: Material Design 中文协同翻译 - design.1sters.com
repos.summary_zh: Material Design 中文协同翻译项目致力于将 Google 官方 Material Design 规范完整翻译为中文，覆盖动画、样式、布局等核心模块，采用 GitHub 协作模式，支持多人参与翻译与校对，最终生成网页和 PDF 文档，助力国内设计师与开发者掌握统一设计语言。
repos.summary_en: This project translates Google's Material Design specification into Chinese collaboratively, covering animation, style, layout, and more. It uses GitHub for open collaboration, enabling translators and reviewers to contribute, with final outputs published as web pages and PDFs to support designers and developers in adopting a unified design language.

repos.description: 做最好的接口管理平台
repos.summary_zh: DOClever 是一款专为中小型团队打造的商业化开源接口管理平台，完全免费并支持内网部署。它提供接口全生命周期管理、可视化调试、Mock 服务、自动化测试、团队协作及多格式导入导出等功能，支持 HTTP/HTTPS 协议及多种参数类型，具备版本控制与快照能力，助力高效开发协作。
repos.summary_en: DOClever is a commercial open-source API management platform, fully free and supportable for on-premise deployment. It offers comprehensive API lifecycle management, visual debugging, Mock services, automated testing, team collaboration, and import/export in multiple formats. Supporting HTTP/HTTPS protocols and various parameter types, it features version control, snapshots, and seamless integration with Postman, Swagger, and RAP.

repos.description: 一个 Linux.do 第三方客户端
repos.summary_zh: FluxDO 是一款基于 Flutter 框架开发的 Linux.do 社区第三方客户端，覆盖 Android、iOS、Windows、macOS 和 Linux 全平台。它采用 Material Design 3 设计语言，集成了 Rust 编写的高性能 DOH（DNS over HTTPS）代理以保障网络安全与防污染，并提供完整的论坛交互、Markdown 编辑及实时消息推送功能。
repos.summary_en: FluxDO is a cross-platform third-party client for the Linux.do community, built with Flutter. It features Material Design 3 and integrates a Rust-based DOH (DNS over HTTPS) proxy for secure, pollution-free networking. The app offers a complete forum experience with Markdown editing, real-time notifications, and native performance across mobile and desktop systems.

repos.description: A high performance open-source forum software written in PHP. Discussions Tags based with Quora/StackOverflow style.
repos.summary_zh: Carbon-Forum 是一款高性能开源 PHP 论坛系统，采用 Quora/StackOverflow 式标签讨论机制，支持移动端适配、实时推送、异步设计和完整 SEO 优化，具备现代通知中心与草稿保存功能，适用于构建高效知识分享社区。
repos.summary_en: Carbon-Forum is a high-performance open-source PHP forum software featuring Quora/StackOverflow-style discussion tags, mobile support, real-time notifications, asynchronous architecture, and full SEO optimization, ideal for building efficient knowledge-sharing communities.

repos.description: MultiAgentPPT 是一个集成了 A2A（Agent2Agent）+ MCP（Model Context Protocol）+ ADK（Agent Development Kit） 架构的智能化演示文稿生成系统，支持通过多智能体协作和流式并发机制
repos.summary_zh: MultiAgentPPT 是基于 A2A+MCP+ADK 架构的多智能体演示文稿生成系统，通过大纲生成、主题拆分、并行调研和流式汇总等智能体协作，实现高质量PPT的自动化生成，支持实时编辑与下载，具备可扩展性和本地模型适配能力。
repos.summary_en: MultiAgentPPT is a multi-agent system leveraging A2A+MCP+ADK architecture to automate PPT generation through outline creation, topic splitting, parallel research, and streaming synthesis. It supports real-time editing, high-quality content, extensibility, and local model compatibility.

repos.description: Flarum - 优雅自由的 PHP 轻社区
repos.summary_zh: Flarum 是一款基于 PHP 和 Mithril 框架的自由开源轻量级论坛软件，以简洁、响应式设计和高度可扩展性为核心特色。它提供完整的 API 支持与模块化扩展机制，适合快速搭建现代化社区平台，采用 MIT 许可证确保完全开放。
repos.summary_en: Flarum is a free, open-source forum software built with PHP and the Mithril JavaScript framework, emphasizing simplicity, responsiveness, and extensibility. It offers a modular architecture with comprehensive APIs for customization, ideal for building modern online communities under MIT license.

repos.description: Full-stack AI agent for coding, files, terminals, tools, research, content, multimodal work, and multi-agent workflows.
repos.summary_zh: ProxyCast 是一款基于 Tauri 的本地优先 AI Agent 创作工作台，整合 Workspace、Skills、MCP 标准能力与 Claw 渠道协作，实现从灵感到可发布内容的闭环流程。支持文档生成、研究整理、多平台异步协作及浏览器/终端扩展执行，适合创作者与知识工作者高效沉淀可复用资产。
repos.summary_en: ProxyCast is a local-first AI Agent workspace built with Tauri, integrating Workspace, Skills, MCP-standardized capabilities, and Claw channel collaboration to close the loop from idea to publishable content. It supports document generation, research organization, cross-platform async workflows, and browser/terminal extensions, ideal for creators and knowledge workers to streamline reusable output.

repos.description: 腾讯会议摸鱼工具
repos.summary_zh: TMSpeech 是一款 Windows 平台的实时语音转文字工具，基于 sherpa-onnx 框架实现中文会议语音识别，支持 WASAPI 内录、实时字幕显示与历史记录保存。具备低 CPU 占用（<5%）、无边框可拖动界面、自定义外部识别器集成等功能，适用于会议转录、走神备忘等场景。
repos.summary_en: TMSpeech is a Windows-based real-time speech-to-text tool using the sherpa-onnx framework for Chinese meeting transcription. It captures system audio via WASAPI, displays live subtitles like lyrics, and saves recognition history. Features include low CPU usage (<5%), draggable UI, and support for custom external recognizers, ideal for meetings and note-taking.

repos.description: :books: 一起写Python文章，一起看Python文章 - 利用readthedocs的Python技术文章的收集和翻译。
repos.summary_zh: PyZh 是一个基于 ReadTheDocs 的 Python 技术文章翻译与收集项目，致力于汇聚优质英文技术文档并提供中文翻译。项目采用 RST 格式编写，支持多语言协作，提供 RSS 订阅和在线浏览功能，鼓励社区共同参与内容创作与翻译。
repos.summary_en: PyZh is a Python technology article translation and collection project built on ReadTheDocs, aiming to aggregate high-quality English technical articles with Chinese translations. It uses RST format, supports collaborative writing, offers RSS subscription and online reading, and encourages community contributions.

repos.description: A free, elegant Markdown editor for macOS, Windows and Linux. Simple by design, always in sync with the file on disk.
repos.summary_zh: ColaMD 是一款专为 AI 智能体协作设计的原生 Markdown 编辑器，支持实时同步 AI 对 .md 文件的修改，具备 WYSIWYG 编辑、多主题支持和跨平台导出功能。其核心亮点在于通过文件监听实现 AI 操作的无缝可视化，让用户像结对编程一样观察智能体工作过程。
repos.summary_en: ColaMD is an Agent-Native Markdown editor designed for real-time collaboration between humans and AI agents. It instantly reflects AI-generated changes to .md files via file system monitoring, featuring WYSIWYG editing, cross-platform support, and theme customization—eliminating manual refresh cycles during agent-assisted writing.

repos.description: 完全免费、开源的多人协作记账 Web App | Completely free, open-source, collaborative accounting Web App
repos.summary_zh: Cent 是一款完全免费、开源的多人协作记账 Web App，基于 GitHub 仓库实现数据同步与版本控制，无需服务器即可跨平台实时协作。支持语音记账、AI 智能分析、多币种管理、地图可视化、周期记账等高级功能，采用纯前端 PWA 架构，数据完全自持于用户私有仓库，保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Cent is a completely free, open-source collaborative accounting web app that uses GitHub repositories for data synchronization and version control, enabling real-time cross-platform collaboration without servers. It supports advanced features like voice记账, AI analysis, multi-currency management, map visualization, and recurring transactions. Built as a pure frontend PWA with data stored in user-owned private repositories for full privacy and security.

repos.description: 完全运行于 Cloudflare Worker的现代聊天系统：实时通信、Telegram 双向桥接、消息与文件加密 A modern, self-hosted team chat built on Cloudflare — realtime messaging, Telegram bridge, encrypted messages & files, and WebMCP. |
repos.summary_zh: EdgeChat 是基于 Cloudflare 全家桶构建的零运维团队聊天系统，支持公开/私有群组、私信与实时消息通信。特色功能为 Telegram 双向消息桥接，Bot 驱动跨平台无缝同步。前端采用 Vue 3 + Hono，Durable Objects 承载 WebSocket 连接，AES-256-GCM 加密保障数据安全，在免费额度内即可落地企业级 IM。
repos.summary_en: EdgeChat is a zero-infrastructure team chat system built on Cloudflare ecosystem, supporting public/private groups, DMs, and real-time messaging. Its standout feature is bidirectional Telegram bridge via Bot for seamless cross-platform sync. Powered by Vue 3 + Hono frontend, Durable Objects for WebSocket, and AES-256-GCM encryption, it delivers enterprise-grade IM within Cloudflare's free tier.

repos.description: 🎙️ An intelligent voice productivity assistant that turns speech into clean text, useful actions, and structured knowledge. It helps users capture ideas, communicate naturally, automate repetitive tasks, and stay productive across different apps and workflows.
repos.summary_zh: Voxt 是一款专为 macOS 设计的语音输入与翻译应用，支持全局热键录音、实时波形显示、多引擎语音识别（本地 MLX 和远程 ASR 服务）及文本增强翻译，具备剪贴板安全粘贴、历史记录管理和多模式触发机制，适用于跨语言实时转录与翻译场景。
repos.summary_en: Voxt is a macOS menu bar app for voice input and translation, featuring global hotkey recording, real-time waveform display, multi-engine speech recognition (local MLX and remote ASR), text enhancement, and clipboard-safe auto-paste. It supports transcription, translation, selected-text processing, and history management with configurable providers.

repos.description: Downloads : https://brahma-dev.github.io/synergy-stable-builds/
repos.summary_zh: Synergy 是一款开源的跨平台输入共享工具，允许用户通过一套键鼠无缝控制多台计算机。支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux，提供简洁的配置与编译流程，适用于多设备办公场景，强调自由使用与二次开发。
repos.summary_en: Synergy is an open-source, cross-platform tool that enables sharing a single mouse and keyboard across multiple computers. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux, with straightforward configuration and build processes, ideal for multi-device productivity environments.

repos.description: Independent iOS client for Lody — native chat, sessions, and coding-agent collaboration on iPhone
repos.summary_zh: 独立开源 iOS 客户端，为 Lody AI 协作平台打造。采用 React Native + Swift 6.0 混合架构，结合 CRDT 数据同步，支持无限聊天、流式文本渲染、代码 Diff 高亮与文件树导航，严格遵循 Apple HIG，提供安全的本地会话与远程服务桥接体验。
repos.summary_en: Independent open-source iOS client for Lody AI platform. Hybrid React Native + Swift 6.0 architecture with CRDT sync (Loro/Flock). Features infinite chat, streaming rendering, code diff highlighting, and file tree. Strictly follows Apple HIG for authentic native experience bridging local sessions and remote services.

repos.description: Android Client for Carbon Forum with Material Design.
repos.summary_zh: Android-Carbon-Forum 是一个基于 Material Design 的 Carbon Forum 论坛 Android 客户端，提供流畅的移动端浏览体验，支持主题查看、发帖、登录、通知推送等功能，采用模块化架构便于二次开发和定制部署。
repos.summary_en: Android-Carbon-Forum is an Android client for Carbon Forum built with Material Design, offering seamless mobile browsing, topic viewing, posting, login, and push notifications. It features a modular architecture for easy customization and deployment.

repos.description: claudeclaw
repos.summary_zh: MateCode 是一个通过 Telegram 远程控制 Claude Code 的桥接工具，支持长期记忆、会话管理、代码高亮等功能。采用纯 Python 标准库开发，基于长轮询实现低延迟通信，所有数据本地存储保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: MateCode is a bridge tool that enables remote control of Claude Code via Telegram, featuring long-term memory, session management, and code highlighting. Built with pure Python standard libraries, it uses long polling for low-latency communication with local SQLite storage for privacy.

repos.description: Carbon Forum HTTP API Documentation.
repos.summary_zh: Carbon Forum HTTP API 文档为开发者提供完整的论坛接口规范，涵盖用户认证、帖子管理、通知系统等核心功能，支持分页浏览、安全验证码及头像上传，适用于构建第三方论坛客户端或集成自动化工具。
repos.summary_en: Carbon Forum HTTP API Documentation provides comprehensive interface specifications for forum operations, including user authentication, topic management, notifications, and avatar handling. It supports pagination, security codes, and is designed for building third-party clients or integrating automation tools.

repos.description: Yet Another Pair Programming Package for Atom.
repos.summary_zh: Coeditor 是一个为 Atom 编辑器设计的实时协同编程插件，支持多用户无冲突文本编辑、语法高亮同步、文件操作同步及项目级协作感知。通过自建 WebSocket 服务器实现客户端间状态同步，适用于远程结对编程场景，需统一配置换行符以避免内容不一致。
repos.summary_en: Coeditor is a real-time collaborative programming plugin for Atom, enabling conflict-free text editing, syntax highlighting sync, file operations, and project awareness across multiple users. It relies on a custom WebSocket server for state synchronization, ideal for remote pair programming, with strict line ending consistency requirements across clients.
